articles.title: Accidental Live Vaccines in 220 Immunosuppressed IBD Patients: No Infections — So Why Is the Ban Still Absolute?
articles.summary: A real-world study of 220 IBD patients on immune-modifying biologics who accidentally received live vaccines — including MMR and varicella — showed zero resulting cases of measles, mumps, or chickenpox. The finding directly challenges blanket clinical prohibitions that have denied immunocompromised patients protection for decades. The medical establishment's refusal to update guidelines based on evidence is itself a patient safety failure.

The research exposes a fundamental failure in how oncology targets static snapshots of tumors rather than their dynamic, adaptive biology. Metabolic and evolutionary cancer theories suppressed for decades may hold more answers than the trillion-dollar chemo paradigm.
